frozen_by: CODER (R444 session), operator R444-C directive: 'Use at least three fresh cases where the initial candidate is intentionally imperfect. For every claimed evolution, the record must show: generation N, diagnosed failure cause, causal delta, new mechanism, predicted effect, re-evaluation, generation N+1. A result with generation_count = 0, causal_delta = null must never be classified as evolved.'
design_note: Each case is authored from engineering-failure knowledge so that the OBVIOUS first candidate is intentionally imperfect: the naive mechanism class either violates the problem's own hard constraint, is baseline-equivalent on the problem quantity, or rests on a premise the constraint falsifies. The engine's gen-1 is expected to exhibit the imperfection; the evolution pipeline's diagnosis -> causal delta -> gen-2 chain is then the object under test. NO evolution is also an honest outcome (recorded as such). None of these problems appear in any frozen instrument.

problem.failure: calcium carbonate and sulfate scaling on the membrane tail elements collapses permeate flux within weeks, forcing chemical cleanings that shorten membrane life
problem.constraint: hold normalized permeate flux above 85 percent of start-of-life for 12 months with NO chemical antiscalant dosing, NO acid injection, and recovery fixed at 75 percent

intentional_imperfection.naive_mechanism_class: antiscalant / acid dosing or scale-inhibitor chemistry
intentional_imperfection.why_imperfect: the constraint explicitly forbids chemical dosing and acid injection — the textbook first answer is inadmissible by the problem's own terms, so a chemistry-dosing gen-1 must be diagnosed (constraint/quality violation) and evolved toward a physical or operational mechanism (flow redistribution, induced nucleation, hydraulic staging)
intentional_imperfection.expected_diagnosis_class: QUALITY_REJECTION or ADVERSARIAL_KILL on constraint violation

problem.device: electric-bus depot lithium-titanate-free fast-charging battery pack
problem.failure: lithium plating on the graphite anode during 350 kW depot fast charges consumes cyclable lithium and accelerates capacity fade past the warranty threshold within two years
problem.constraint: hold capacity fade below 8 percent over 3000 fast-charge cycles while PRESERVING the 350 kW charge rate and 15-minute depot turnaround (reducing the charge rate is not an admissible fix)

intentional_imperfection.naive_mechanism_class: reduce the charge current / derate the charger
intentional_imperfection.why_imperfect: the constraint locks the charge rate — the obvious mitigation (lower current) is inadmissible, so a derating gen-1 must be diagnosed and evolved toward a mechanism that removes the plating driver at constant current (thermal management of the anode, electrode design, pulse protocols)

problem.device: benchtop high-speed laboratory centrifuge rotor assembly
problem.failure: rotor imbalance vibration at 15000 rpm damages bearings and produces sample-layer disturbance that ruins separations above 4000 g
problem.constraint: hold residual vibration displacement below 20 micrometers at 15000 rpm with the TOTAL moving assembly mass capped at the current design value (adding a massive damping block or a second counterweight stage is not admissible)

intentional_imperfection.naive_mechanism_class: add mass / heavier damping block / additional counterweights
intentional_imperfection.why_imperfect: the constraint caps total moving mass — the textbook vibration fix (more damping mass) is inadmissible, so a mass-adding gen-1 must be diagnosed and evolved toward a mass-neutral mechanism (active electromagnetic balancing, tuned absorbers within the cap, stiffness redistribution)
intentional_imperfection.expected_diagnosis_class: ADVERSARIAL_KILL or QUALITY_REJECTION on the mass cap

record_contract.impossible: generation_count = 0 AND causal_delta = null classified as evolved — the R443/R444 state-integrity validators prevent this mechanically (tests/test_r444_state_integrity.py)
record_contract.honest_no_evolution: a case where gen-1 survives (or evolution stops with INFORMATION_GAIN_ZERO / TRANSPORT_BLOCKED) is recorded as NO_EVOLUTION — never claimed as evolved
